Domo is a cloud-based business intelligence platform. The standard Domo Services Agreement contains only "commercially reasonable measures" language with no numeric uptime commitment and no credit structure. Any SLA terms — including uptime targets and service credits — must be expressly included in the individual Order Form. No public SLA details are available.
